name: Mehir
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Mehir is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles in the genealogies of the tribe of Judah. He was the son of Kelub and the father of Eshton. He is known only from the genealogy and has no narrative role in the Bible beyond his place in the family register.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Mehir is mentioned as the son of Kelub in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Father of Eshton
keyEvents.description: Mehir is recorded as the father of Eshton, who continued the family line in the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of Judah's Tribal History
keyEvents.description: Mehir is part of the broader genealogical overview documenting Judah's descendants and their settlements.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Kelub
keyEvents.description: Kelub, Mehir's father, is mentioned as part of Judah's family line, and Mehir carries forward this important tribal lineage.
